about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: From Bangkok streets to Skudai's heart
about.storyContent: Makan Moments Cafe (食光记忆) opened its doors in October 2024 in Taman Impian Emas, Skudai. We bring authentic Thai flavors with a Malaysian twist — a fusion born from passion for both cuisines. Our cozy corner shop features hand-drawn wall art, indoor plants, and natural ventilation, creating the perfect spot to enjoy a meal with friends and family.
about.valueQualityDesc: Fresh ingredients, authentic recipes, and dishes prepared with care.
about.valueCommunityDesc: A neighborhood cafe where everyone is welcome.
about.valueHalalDesc: No pork, no lard — everyone can enjoy our food with confidence.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.controllerDesc: Makan Moments Cafe (Kafe Kenangan Makan) is the data controller responsible for your personal data. You can contact us at:
privacy.dataCollectedDesc: When you use our pre-order service, we collect the following personal data:
privacy.dataPhone: Contact phone number — to notify you about your order status
privacy.dataPayment: Payment screenshot — to verify your Touch & Go deposit
privacy.dataOrder: Order details — items, quantity, total amount, and estimated arrival time
privacy.purposeDesc: We collect your personal data solely for the following purposes under the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (Act 709):
privacy.purpose2: Sending order status notifications via WhatsApp
privacy.retentionDesc: Your personal data is retained only as long as necessary:
privacy.retention1: Order records: retained for 90 days after order completion, then automatically deleted
privacy.retention2: Payment screenshots: deleted within 7 days after payment confirmation
privacy.retention3: Contact numbers: deleted together with the associated order record
privacy.rightsDesc: Under the PDPA 2010, you have the right to:
privacy.right1: Access your personal data held by us
privacy.right2: Request correction of inaccurate personal data
privacy.right3: Request deletion of your personal data
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the details above.
privacy.thirdPartyDesc: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties, except:
privacy.thirdParty1: WhatsApp messaging service — to deliver order notifications to your phone number
privacy.thirdParty2: Our database hosting provider (Neon) — for secure data storage
privacy.cookiesDesc: Our website uses browser local storage to save your order history and tray contents for your convenience. No tracking cookies are used for advertising purposes.
privacy.changesDesc: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
